thread:
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT ALERT] gpu-pool-us-east-2 nodegroup-7 experiencing repeated CUDA OOMs. 23 container restarts in 5m, latency spikes. Headroom metric reports ~18% free across nodes. Auto-retries firing. Please triage.
Ken: I'm on it. checking logs + dashboards.
Disha: quick note — this smells like reserve/fragmentation rather than raw memory exhaustion. we've seen cases where headroom % looks ok but alloc fails because of reserved block alignment + KV cache prefetch.
Maria: any customer reports yet?
Alex: Support seeing a handful of 500s mapped to inference endpoints in us-east-2. Two customers flagged degraded tail latency and occasional failures.
Ken: getting diag bundle from node-7-3 now. pulling dmesg + runtime logs.
Disha: if this is the usual shadow-reserve case, we'll see logs like:
```
E CUDA: out of memory allocating 125MiB (code 2)
E runtime: attempted reserve of 256MiB from sparepool failed, available contiguous=96MiB
W allocator: fragmentation hole: reserved_blocks=4, free_blocks=7, slab_miss=1
```
Ken: paste from node-7-3 (recent):
```
2024-11-02T16:02:12Z runtime WARN memory: failed allocation 0x7f3a... size=134217728
2024-11-02T16:02:12Z cuda ERROR: out of memory, device=0, free=890MiB total=8192MiB
2024-11-02T16:02:12Z reserve INFO: sparepool claim failed, contiguous_free=88MiB, requested=128MiB
```
Disha: yep matches. headroom % is aggregated, doesn't capture contiguous free chunk size. fragmentation + reserved pinned blocks for KV cache prefetch causing allocation failure.
Ken: ops-bot — did autoscaler add new nodes?
ops-bot: Autoscaler attempted scale up +2 nodes at 16:03:05. Failed: quota.vpc.instances.limit_reached for project-redwood-prod.
Ken: that explains why we couldn't get more contiguous space.
Disha: mitigation plan — fast path: 1) disable KV prefetch on the most promiscuous models (temp config) 2) force-evict large reserved blocks from sparepool on affected nodes 3) roll nodes with drain to recombine free space 4) push a conservative reserve config (GpuReserveFraction=0.18 -> 0.12) to reduce fragmentation for short term.
Ken: I can flip prefetch off per route. sending curl to control-plane API now:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control-plane/redwood/v1/routes/route-abc/actions -d '{"op":"set","kv_prefetch":false}'
```
Ken: done for route-abc and route-xr. noticed immediate drop in retry rate for those endpoints.
Alex: customer impact update: two enterprise customers (cust-phi, cust-zen) saw 502/504s between 16:02-16:08. We're drafting an incident note.
Sasha: I'll prepare a short status message: "We're investigating GPU allocation failures causing transient inference errors in us-east-2. We're mitigating by disabling aggressive KV prefetching and rolling affected nodes; ETA ~30-60m." want to include any RCA hints?
Disha: keep it high level — mention allocation fragmentation and node scaling quota as contributing factors. technical RCA after triage.
Ken: started rolling nodegroup-7 with `kubectl drain` and `kubectl cordon` then restart runtime on each. observed one node where sparepool had fragmented holes but after restart contiguous free jumped from ~92MiB -> 904MiB.
Maria: I'm taking over the incident from Ken at 16:18. switching pager to me. Ken handing off notes in #runbook-docs.
Ken: handing off — actions taken: disabled prefetch on 4 routes, kicked nodegroup-7 roll (3/7 done), asked infra for temporary quota bump, customer notify drafted by Sasha.
Maria: I'll continue: 1) finish node roll 2) run sparepool compaction command on remaining nodes (`/opt/runtime/bin/evict_reserved --force`) 3) monitor headroom contig metric and OOM events 4) coordinate with infra for quota resolution.
Disha: after compaction we should also consider a medium-term tweak: reduce default reserved_block_size from 64MiB -> 32MiB for affected runtime builds to mitigate large-hole behaviour. schedule follow-up.
Alex: customer's interim post ready. will send once Maria confirms stable.
ops-bot: Quota request submitted to cloud team at 16:21:42 (req-7731).
Maria: compaction command ran on node-7-5, node-7-6. observed reclaim of ~640MiB contiguous on each. OOM events dropping.
Disha: running a cursory grep for "reserve claim failed" in last 30m shows 87 events -> now 4 events after actions.
Ken: can we add a short term automated alert for contiguous_free < 128MiB per device? we only have percent threshold currently.
Maria: noted, opening ticket for alerting change.
Sasha: sent customer status at 16:35. customers acknowledged — want postmortem.
Alex: support will follow up with affected customers in <1h with mitigation summary.
Maria: incident moving to monitoring. keeping this thread open for next 2h while we watch for regressions.
Disha: follow-ups: - RCA RCA: fragmentation + reserved-block pinning + autoscaler fail due to quota - Mitigation doc: prefetch kill-switch and compaction runbook - Long-term: smaller reserve blocks, contiguous_free alert, scheduler affinity tweak to avoid mixing heavy-prefetch pods with latency-sensitive ones.
Ken: thanks all. great quick coordination.
oncall-bot: Incident update: moved to MONITORING at 16:38. severity -> reduced to SEV-3.
Maria: recording handoff closure notes in incident tracker. will file detailed RCA and link here when ready.
Sasha: thx, will ask CS to prepare customer-facing RCA draft.
Ken: I'll follow up on alerting ticket.
Disha: leaving a snippet for the RCA draft: "root cause: allocator fragmentation + pinned reserved blocks from KV cache prefetch; remediation: disable prefetch during high memory churn, run sparepool compaction, reduce reserved block size, and enforce contiguous-free alerting."
Maria: last check 16:56 — OOM events per minute back to baseline. closing active mitigation.
Sasha: sending final customer note now.
Ken: closing own pager.
oncall-bot: thread archived to incidents archive at 17:03.
